notes.title: Level editor and Steam Workshop update
notes.notes:
[b] Hello everybody![/b]

As some of you have already noticed, we’ve been working on interLOGIC level editor and Steam workshop integration.

We had some trouble because of discontinuation of Rotorz tile system, which we used for our games:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/563150/interLOGIC/] interLOGIC link[/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/586170/Mad_Dojo/] MadDojo link[/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/460910/AGents/]A-Gents link[/url]

so promised updates for these games are long overdue.
We took the time while we were developing Dead Link: Pages Torn to develop our own auto-tile system and level editor, and we bring it to you for testing in our latest update of interLOGIC.

Feel free to create, publish and download custom levels in interLOGIC.
Now that we have our own tool at disposal, you can expect updates for our other games soon.
Thank you for your patience, and we hope you’ll enjoy this update. Of course, bug reports and suggestions about new features are always welcome.

Have fun!

[b]P.S. A new pack with 10 levels also included ;) [/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hhy_mrXSGmM
